home.intro: Set the readings from the home sensors, then play. Noa Guardian applies the rules below minute by minute.
home.replay: Change the readings and play again

live.check: Noa Voice is asking {{n}} to say a sentence.

home.called: 998 (UAE ambulance) called at {{at}}. The rest of the journey follows.
home.tryAnother: Try another case, or change the readings and play again.

speech.ask: {{at}} · Noa Voice: “{{q}} Please say after me:”
speech.askDaily: Noa Voice: “Good morning, {{n}}. Please say this for me.”
speech.noMic: Speaking needs a browser with speech recognition, such as Chrome or Edge. Type it, or use a sample.
speech.micOff: The microphone is off for this page. Type it, or use a sample.
speech.unavailable: Speech-to-text is not available here. Type it, or use a sample.
speech.noWords: No words came through. Try again, or use a sample.
speech.failed: Speech-to-text did not start. Type it, or use a sample.

next.ask: What happens next: Noa asks one more question about what changed. No answer, or slurred speech, means a 998 (UAE ambulance) call.
next.call: What happens next: no answer or slurred speech, so Noa calls 998 (UAE ambulance) now.
next.decided: What happens next: Noa has decided; see the decision below.

speech.demo: Demo rule: words matched and time taken, compared with the usual. Not a validated stroke test.

btn.read: Read what arrived on the hospital screen, then:

teach.passed: Teach-back passed: Noa checks the person understood
teach.planSent: Plan sent to the phone app

recheck.coach: Noa Coach: “Drink the juice by your bed now. I’ll check again in 15 minutes.”
recheck.recoveredText: A small snack now. Navigator tells the doctor in the morning.
recheck.stillLowText: Noa Coach: “Another 15 g of sugar, please.” If the next check is still low, Responder calls 998.
recheck.note: Try a value under 4.0 twice to see Noa escalate to 998.

daily.alertNote: A dose question for the clinician, not a reminder.
daily.onTargetText: Noa keeps watching. Nobody is bothered.
daily.redNote: In real use, a failed speech check here would start the emergency path again. Use the usual speech to continue this case.

accept.doneText: {{act}}. The clinician decides; Noa Coach explains the change and checks understanding.
accept.nothingText: The reading was on target, so Noa sent nothing. Go back and enter an off-target reading to see this step act.

report.title: Department of Health · {{title}} · October 2026 · no names
report.fictional: Fictional figures for the demo. This person is counted as one anonymous case.

phone.helpText: Noa is calling for help now.
phone.drink: Drink the juice by your bed now.
phone.getUp: Let’s get you up slowly. I’m here.
phone.nurse: I’ve booked your nurse for today.
phone.allWell: All is well. Rest now; I’m keeping watch.
phone.voiceTitle: Noa Voice · phone rings, screen flashes
phone.watching: Noa watches quietly. Nobody is woken unless a rule is met.
phone.changedPlan: Changed your plan today. Noa explained it.

web.empty: No updates. {{f1}} and {{f2}} hear from Noa only if something happens.
